notes: Two routes: «أخبرني عمرو» (Ibn Wahb's) and «وقال بكر بن مضر عن عمرو بن الحارث» are full chains that meet at Amr; the names after «عمرو بن الحارث» are written once and shared (rule 3).
«أن كريبا، مولى ابن عباس حدثه» is a link (rule 5); Umm Salama is the third occurrence of «أم سلمة» in the text, the one who says «سمعت النبي».
Aisha's «سل أم سلمة» is a referral in the scene, not a transmission; Ibn Abbas's aside and the senders are scene only.
The archive flagged uncertainty about three or more routes; the reading above is the one this reader holds.
